title: Verdant 14 — Modern Institutional Interiors for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled & Godot: Office, Lobby & Studio [16x16]
tagline: 635 tiles at 16x16. Office, lobby, corridor and studio, with 11 complete 47-mask sets.
description:
635 tiles at 16x16. A modern working building: an open-plan office, a lobby, a corridor spine and a studio — with 11 complete 47-mask autotile sets, 20 objects, 3 animated sets and ready importers for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled and Godot.

Every other pack in the Verdant series is a landscape. This one is the building.

What is in it

  • 24 floor and division tiles — 6 materials, four variants each: contract carpet, sheet vinyl, lobby terrazzo, a power-floated concrete slab, a demountable partition and a glazed screen.
  • 517 transition tiles in 11 complete 47-mask blob sets — every edge, every outer corner, every inner corner, every single. That is 81% of the pack: this is boundaries, not swatches.
  • 20 objects across 70 tiles. Each ships transparent, so you can drop it on your own ground, AND grounded on ours with the contact shadow already between them.
  • 3 animated sets x 4 frames — a server rack whose activity lights flicker, a desk monitor with a live trace, a photocopier whose scan lamp sweeps under the platen. In all of them the silhouette is identical in every frame and only the light moves.
  • A finished sample map — 34x24 cells, 87 distinct tiles, 44 objects — as a PNG, as JSON naming every cell by id, and as a Tiled .tmx.

The autotile sets

`carpet_on_lino` · `terraz_on_lino` · `screed_on_lino` · `carpet_on_terraz` · `parti_on_carpet` · `parti_on_lino` · `parti_on_terraz` · `parti_on_screed` · `glaze_on_carpet` · `glaze_on_lino` · `glaze_on_screed`

Import it tonight

  • RPG Maker MZ — a full A2 autotile sheet at 48px, plus B/C/D object sheets and a slot map. 48 / 16 = 3, so the upscale is pure pixel replication with no resampling. Every shape MZ can request was composed back out of the sheet using the engine's own FLOOR_AUTOTILE_TABLE and compared byte-for-byte: 528 of 528 identical.
  • Godot — a .tres TileSet. It was loaded headless in Godot 4.7.2 and Godot itself was made to COUNT: all 635 declared tiles built, every atlas source resolved, every multi-cell footprint exact.
  • Tiled — one .tsx per group. Every one was opened and rendered by Tiled 1.10.2's own tmxrasterizer and compared to the shipped sheet, tile by tile. The sample .tmx renders pixel-for-pixel identical to the shipped PNG: 835,584 pixels compared, 0 differ.
  • Anything else — loose PNGs, packed sheets, and a tiles.json giving every tile's id, role, material, sheet slot, tiling mode and autotile mask.

⛔ How to paint it — read this before you start

Paint the vinyl everywhere with no holes in it, then each layer on top of the last: carpet, terrazzo and concrete on the vinyl; a carpet suite on the terrazzo; the partitions and glazed screens last. In an autotiled map only ONE side of any boundary is ever drawn — the material laid on top — which is what every X_on_Y name means. Cut a hole in the vinyl where the carpet goes instead, and the vinyl's own edge tiles will paint their outside edge into your carpet and put a line of the wrong floor around every room. The included sample map is built in exactly those four layers.

The value structure, since it is the part you cannot see

The four floors are spread across the value axis on purpose, so every one reads against the others AND against the partition dividing them. A mid-grey wall on a mid-grey floor is invisible at this size, so the partition is dark — and that was measured before any art was drawn, not discovered afterwards. Separation ratio is |midLuma(raised) − midLuma(ground)| / span(ground), from emitted pixels, floor 1.0:

parti on carpet 2.34 · on concrete 2.52 · on terrazzo 4.57 · on vinyl 6.77

There is deliberately no glaze-on-terrazzo set. Pale glass on pale terrazzo measures 0.48, under the floor, so it is not in this pack — the lobby's screens are the solid partition. Shipping a set you cannot see would have made the grid look complete and given you a wall nobody can find.

What is proven, and what is not

  • Exact grid. Every cell exactly 16x16; every sheet an exact multiple.
  • Palette lock. Every opaque pixel falls inside the declared 66-colour palette. That is what makes tile 600 match tile 1.
  • No anti-aliasing. Alpha is strictly binary. Nothing has been scaled, filtered or blended anywhere in the pipeline.
  • Autotile completeness. All 517 mask slots across 11 sets, checked.
  • Footprint truth. Every tile's declared cell footprint equals its actual pixel size, in both directions.
  • The sheets match the loose tiles. The pack ships its art twice on purpose and all 635 were compared file by file.

⚠️ What is NOT claimed: "mechanically proven seamless." Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed by eye — but a statistical seam test cannot prove seamlessness and this pack will not tell you it can. The 4x4 proof renders ship in proof/repetition/ so you can look for the grid line yourself.

⚠️ Godot: headless load and resource inspection — not the editor GUI, not a running game. Tiled: the CLI renderer, not the GUI editor. RPG Maker MZ: the sheet composes correctly against MZ's own autotile table; MZ is not installed on the build machine, so that is not a claim to have opened it in the editor.

AI disclosure
